exposure: MCCS group vs. planned VB group
cohort: 64 women planning MCCS and 113 women planning VB in their first pregnancy
finding: There were few differences in maternal and perinatal outcomes between women who chose caesarean section and those who planned vaginal birth in uncomplicated first pregnancies.
mod_finding: The study found few differences in outcomes between maternal-choice caesarean section and planned vaginal birth.
